text:
Harper (PM): quick follow-up from the Q&A 1: teams want a single canonical set of target windows + explicit go/no-go gates for API v2, Console GA, and Optimize cost tooling. can leadership confirm what we can share externally?

Sophie (CEO): short answer: yes. publish target windows as "targets" (not commitments). we'll provide a canary health update ~10 days after canary starts.

Evan (Eng): engineering context: API v2 surface is feature-frozen. remaining items: one perf kernel and a quantization validation. rollout pattern: 7d canary -> 7d ramp -> opt-in -> GA if no P1s and perf gates hold.

Priya (Platform): Console depends on migration tooling + RBAC parity. plan: internal dry-run in Aug, invited beta in Sep, GA in Oct. ops requires a rollback-tested runbook and 48h post-migration monitoring.

Marta (DevRel): partners need a short matrix (beta vs GA), feature-flag names, and SDK snippets. product should publish a 1-pager + sample scripts.

Harper (PM): draft targets (provisional):
- API v2: canary ~ 2026-08-09, GA target ~ 2026-09-22
- Console: invited beta ~ 2026-09-15, GA target ~ 2026-10-07
- Optimize (cost hints): opt-in preview ~ 2026-09-03, public beta ~ 2026-09-25
(note: dates are targets subject to canary and migration runbook sign-off)

Evan (Eng): propose acceptance gates for API v2: security audit cleared, P99 latency <= 1.25x baseline, token cost regression <= 1.15x, no memory growth after 72h soak. I'll post the perf checklist to eng board.

Priya (Platform): Console gates: successful dry-run on 3 tenants, rollback script validated, runbook <30m/tenant, and 48h monitoring green. ops will sign off after monitoring window.

Marta (DevRel): partner comms checklist: feature-flag names, SDK changelog, migration scripts, and a short troubleshooting doc. I'll draft the FAQ and sample scripts.

Harper (PM): action owners: 1) Harper -> publish one-pager + feature matrix; 2) Evan -> final perf checklist; 3) Priya -> schedule dry-runs + publish runbook; 4) Marta -> partner FAQ + scripts. I'll post links here by Thursday EOD.

status-bot: scheduled: canary-reserve job queued for 2026-08-04 08:00 UTC.

Sophie (CEO): decision: share targets labeled "target / provisional" and provide a canary health update ~10 days after canary start. keep updates short in this thread so partners have a single source. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
